verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public Lindy API, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404, so there is nothing showing API parity with the UI. The MCP and API mentions describe Lindy consuming other products' tools and APIs as a client, which is a different capability and earns no credit here. Slack commands are a chat interface, not a programmatic API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
